body: Bootstrap resolution: preparation establishes controller authority on the PRIVATE device before projector activation; no controller approves itself. Public Stage starts unbound and displays a short-lived, single-use, non-authorizing `display_join_id`. Already-authenticated controller submits it with requested deck/session; coordinator CAS-binds the Stage, issues only AudienceDisplaySession, increments displayBindingEpoch, and shows both sides the deck/session/display fingerprint before activation. Stage cannot approve, mint controller scope, or reach private topics. Pairing a new controller is a separate transaction requiring current controller approval or owner reauth recovery; do not conflate it with display binding.
summary: Bootstrap resolution fixed without authority cycle
